messages.subject: longitudinal measurement invariance + residual correlations
parts:
Dear all,

I am trying to test a questionnaire for longitudinal measurement invariance (three timepoints).
First, I fitted single models for every timepoint. Modification indices pointed out residual correlations of two items. So I included them in each single confirmatory factor analyis.Example:

model_swls_t3a <- "
swls_t3 =~ swls1_t3+ swls2_t3+ swls3_t3+ swls4_t3+swls5_t3
swls4_t3 ~~ swls5_t3
"
fit_swls_t3a<-cfa(model_swls_t3a, data = swls, estimator = "MLM")
summary(fit_swls_t3a, standardized = TRUE, fit.measures = TRUE)

The fit indices were quite good. E.G for this model: 
 Number of observations                          2334

  Degrees of freedom                                 4           4

    for the Satorra-Bentler correction

User model versus baseline model:

  Comparative Fit Index (CFI)                    0.999       1.000
  Tucker-Lewis Index (TLI)                       0.998       0.999


For the next step, I wanted to fit the configural model over the tree time points, incluing the residual correlations:
model_swlsconfig <- '
swls_t1 =~ swls1_t1+ swls2_t1+ swls3_t1+ swls4_t1
swls_t2 =~ swls1_t2+ swls2_t2+ swls3_t2+ swls4_t2
swls_t3 =~ swls1_t3+ swls2_t3+ swls3_t3+ swls4_t3


swls4_t1~~swls5_t1
swls4_t2~~swls5_t2
swls4_t3~~swls5_t3

swls_t1 ~~ swls_t2
swls_t1~~ swls_t3
swls_t2 ~~ swls_t3

swls1_t1~~swls1_t2
swls2_t1~~swls2_t2
swls3_t1~~swls3_t2
swls4_t1~~swls4_t2

swls1_t1~~swls1_t3
swls2_t1~~swls2_t3
swls3_t1~~swls3_t3
swls4_t1~~swls4_t3

swls1_t2~~swls1_t3
swls2_t2~~swls2_t3
swls3_t2~~swls3_t3
swls4_t2~~swls4_t3

swls4_t1~~swls5_t1
swls4_t2~~swls5_t2
swls4_t3~~swls5_t3

'
However, fit indices indicated a bad fit of the model to the data!  The fit indices for the single confirmatory factor analysis were much better! Did I miss anything in the syntax for the configural model? When I fit the configural model without the residual correlations, fit indices are acceptable- but better than with residual correlations (taht confuses me!)
